_what: 2027 IIHF World Junior Championship (World Juniors page). Edit 'rosters' when the national teams name their rosters (mid-December): country code -> player names exactly as listed. 'status' notes are shown on the page as written.
name: 2027 IIHF World Junior Championship
eligibility: A player can't have been born earlier than 2007 (IIHF U20 rule).
status: Norway's spot: on November 8 the Norwegian association said the IIHF had removed Norway to make room for Russia; on November 15 the IIHF confirmed Russia can't take part because of the Canadian government's position. The sources checked on November 19 don't say whether Norway was put back.
Russian players can't play in this tournament.
